items.html: But to the Nukva, only the point of her Keter came at first, and all the corrections come into her; and afterward the rest of the nine all come in addition at once, without the need of pregnancy, nursing, and mochin as in ZA, but everything is done at once. And also understand that the name BaN, from which is the root of Cain, being there in the Daat of ZA, gives a drop in the manner of an actual coupling, and they are male Gevurot; and that which emerges for the correction of the Partzuf of the Nukva are female, as above.
